Springfield, Ills. June 11<sup>th</sup> 1860
Rev. W<sup>m</sup> C. Whitcomb
My dear Sir:

Yours of the 15<sup>th</sup> inquir-
ing whether I am of, or related to,
the New-England family of Lincolns,
is received— M<hi rend="superscript">r</hi>. Solomon Lincoln
of Hingham, Mass. once enlisted me
in an inquiry of the same kind,
which ended in an impression, on
my part that we are remotely re-
lated, but that our ancestry parted
in Old England— Yours, a puritan
stock, coming to New-England, and
mine, a quaker stock, coming to
Pennsylvania— There is no great
certainty in this, but it is the strong-
est impression I now have upon the
subject—

Very Respectfully
A. Lincoln
